title: Concept: BigQuery error detail disclosed in a response
description: A BigQuery syntax error with the job location in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The message repeats the failing column and the job id, and the location reveals which regional dataset holds the data.
applicability: Deployments that render a BigQuery syntax error with the job location into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The message repeats the failing column and the job id, and the location reveals which regional dataset holds the data.
